title: Alexis Castro Scores Historic Goal in First Libertadores Match
seoTitle: Alexis Castro Scores Historic Goal in First Libertadores.
subtitle: The forward opened the scoring just four minutes into the match against Estudiantes, sparking great fan interest
excerpt: Alexis Castro scored the second-fastest goal in Corinthians' Libertadores knockout stage history, just four minutes into the match against Estudiantes.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Alexis Castro's name resurfaced in searches after the forward opened the scoring against Estudiantes, just four minutes into the first half of the first leg of the Libertadores quarter-finals. The goal, which came from a rebound off Hugo Souza, was the second-fastest in Corinthians' history in knockout stage matches of the tournament.

What Happened in the First Half

In the match played in La Plata, Corinthians and Estudiantes drew 1-1. Castro's goal came early when Hugo Souza's rebound found the forward, who finished without delay. Estudiantes responded with Kaio César, also four minutes into the second half, securing the draw that will take the decision to the Neo Química Arena.

How Castro's Goal Stands Out in Club Statistics

Castro's goal became the second-fastest in Corinthians' Libertadores knockout stage history, surpassing most goals scored by the club in decisive clashes. The 1-1 draw keeps alive Corinthians' tradition of advancing when they draw the first leg, as occurred in seven of the previous eight occasions.

Corinthians' Home Performance

Corinthians has shown the highest ball possession rate as home team in this edition, with 67% dominance. This statistic reinforces coach Fernando Diniz's strategy to seek control of the game when playing at home, especially at Neo Química Arena, where the team usually decides matches.

Estudiantes' Away Statistics

Estudiantes, in turn, records 41% ball possession in away games, and in the La Plata match, half of their 14 shots came from set pieces, including Castro's goal, which originated from a corner kick.

Next Steps for the Decider

With the draw, a simple victory for Corinthians at Neo Química Arena will secure their qualification for the semi-finals. Another draw will lead to a penalty shootout. The next match will be decisive in determining who will continue in the competition.
